title: Add an offline root homepage for all existing local HTML reports

Include historical reports without inferring validation from existence/mtime. Relative percent-encoded URLs preserve navigation when moving the whole checkout; all links work without JavaScript.

No runtime build, extraction, coverage regeneration or game execution. Python3.9+ standard-library mode also available.
